items.name: WSL2
items.undo: Turn the WSL and Virtual Machine Platform features off again in Windows Features, then restart.

items.name: Docker Engine in WSL2
items.undo: Unregister the crsp-docker WSL distro: wsl --unregister crsp-docker. Your own distros are not touched.
manual_steps: wsl -d crsp-docker -u root -- apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl
Add Docker's apt source for Ubuntu noble as in https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu/
wsl -d crsp-docker -u root -- apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
wsl -d crsp-docker -u root -- systemctl enable --now docker

items.name: Docker Desktop
items.licence_note: Docker Desktop is free for small businesses, personal use, education and open source. Larger companies (over 250 employees or over 10 million US dollars revenue) need a paid subscription. crsp does not judge licences.
items.undo: Uninstall Docker Desktop from Windows Settings, Apps.
manual_steps: Download Docker Desktop from https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/ and run the installer.

items.name: Docker Engine
items.undo: Remove the docker-ce packages and the package source that crsp added: apt-get remove (or dnf remove) docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin, then the docker.list or docker-ce.repo file.
manual_steps: sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

Fedora or Red Hat family: follow https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/fedora/ (or /rhel/, /centos/): sudo dnf config-manager addrepo or --add-repo the docker-ce.repo, then sudo dnf install docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin, then sudo systemctl enable --now docker

items.name: Docker Desktop
items.licence_note: Docker Desktop is free for small businesses, personal use, education and open source. Larger companies need a paid subscription. crsp does not judge licences. Homebrew must already be installed; the first start asks you for one system permission at this Mac.
items.undo: Quit Docker Desktop and run: brew uninstall --cask docker-desktop
manual_steps: Approve the system prompt once at this Mac. Without Homebrew: download Docker Desktop from https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/ and open it.
